title: LLM Integration in .NET
description: Integrate OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, and local models into .NET applications with proper error handling and streaming.
longDescription: Build production-ready LLM integrations: OpenAI and Azure OpenAI SDKs, local model integration with Ollama or llama.cpp, streaming responses, error handling, retry logic, rate limiting, and cost optimization.
whatYouLearn: Error handling, retries, and rate limiting
